name: Tonari no Vampire
original_name: となりのヴァンパイア
source: The protagonist goes to explore a Western-style building that is rumored to have a ghost. There he finds his classmate sleeping inside a coffin, as in reality she is a vampire.
translation: 主人公前去探索一栋传闻闹鬼的西式建筑，却在那里发现自己的同班同学睡在棺材里——原来她其实是一名吸血鬼。
